title: Don't Be Evil Yourself
style: Candy pop; close-miked breath detail over a sustained subbass drone, bright synth-pop chords and crisp electronic percussion; low, dark whispering vocals with stacked harmonies lifting the hooks; steady midtempo pulse opening into an anthemic chorus.
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Some wrongs are heavier, and this is true:
The tyrant’s cruelty outweighs the slight.
To rank our harms by depth is sound and right,
A compass pointing where our help is due.

[Pre-Chorus]
Greater wrongs deserve priority.
Be it hurt the most or the minority.

[Chorus]
Be right, do it right, respect!
Take care, do not harm, protect!
Denounce evil, don't be evil yourself!

[Verse 2]
Yet lesser harm is harm, and does not buy
Its pardon from the greater evil’s shade.
No guilt dissolves, no debt is ever paid
By pointing out a worse one standing by.

[Pre-Chorus]
Lesser wrongs remain wrong.
Causing harm does not belong.

[Chorus]
Be right, do it right, respect!
Take care, do not harm, protect!
Denounce evil, don't be evil yourself!

[Verse 3]
And grant you hold the clearer, truer view:
It gives you no commission to inflict.
The zeal that bruises those it would convict
Becomes a second wrong, and wounds anew.

[Pre-Chorus]
Right views do not permit harm.
Whatever hurts is no charm.

[Chorus]
Be right, do it right, respect!
Take care, do not harm, protect!
Denounce evil, don't be evil yourself!

[Verse 4]
So let the better cause be shown through care.
A righteous force that wounds forfeits its claim.
The gentler hand, no fanfare, no acclaim,
Alone can prove the goodness that we swear.

[Pre-Chorus]
Gentleness alone proves righteousness.
Not being kind is just mindlessness.

[Chorus]
Be right, do it right, respect!
Take care, do not harm, protect!
Denounce evil, don't be evil yourself!

[Outro]
Being wrong at being right
it's just being wrong
so don't
